title.zh: 跨國合資企業 (JV) 與戰略聯盟 (CEO / 法務長 視角)
title.en: Cross-Border Joint Venture (JV) & Strategic Alliance (CEO/GC Perspective)

slide_title.zh: 海外市場壁壘與合資戰略訴求 (SCQA & The JV Mandate)

zh: 情境 (Situation)：為獲取 [特定海外市場/關鍵技術] 的龐大紅利，我們必須快速建立在地化營運，但受限於當地法規的外資持股上限與通路壁壘
衝突 (Complication)：100% 獨資 (Greenfield) 耗時且合規風險極高，但傳統的合資企業 (JV) 失敗率高達 60%，主因多為董事會僵局與核心 IP 外流
戰略訴求 (The Ask)：提議與 [在地戰略夥伴] 成立合資企業，懇請董事會核准 [X 萬] 之初期出資額，並授權法務與戰略團隊啟動「股東協議 (SHA)」談判
en: Situation: To capture massive upside in [Specific Foreign Market/Tech], we must rapidly establish localized operations, though we face strict foreign ownership caps and distribution barriers.
Complication: A 100% Greenfield approach is too slow and legally perilous. However, Joint Ventures (JVs) suffer a 60% failure rate, typically destroyed by board deadlocks and IP leakage.

The Ask: Proposing a Joint Venture with [Local Strategic Partner]. Requesting Board approval for [$X] in initial capitalization and mandating Legal/Strategy to negotiate the definitive Shareholders' Agreement (SHA).

speaker_notes.zh: 各位董事，面對這塊流著奶與蜜的新市場，我們無法單打獨鬥，『合資 (JV)』是我們唯一的快速通道。然而，JV 就像一場高風險的商業婚姻，多數的 JV 不是死於市場競爭，而是死於合資雙方的內部鬥爭。今天的提案，是要在簽字結婚前，透過最強大的法理與治理架構，確保我們掌握控制權，並守住我們的核心資產。
speaker_notes.en: Members of the Board, to penetrate this highly regulated, lucrative market, a Joint Venture is our only viable fast-track. However, a JV is a high-risk corporate marriage. Most JVs are not destroyed by competitors; they implode from internal partner friction. Today's mandate ensures that before we sign the registry, we architect airtight legal and governance structures to guarantee operational control and ring-fence our core assets.

slide_title.zh: 股權架構與實質控制權 (Equity Structure & Operational Control)

zh: 股權與投票權脫鉤 (Economic vs. Voting Rights)：即便因當地法規我方僅能持有 49% 股權，必須透過章程設計取得「董事會過半席次」或「黃金否決權」
重大保留事項 (Reserved Matters)：在股東協議中明確表列 15 項「重大保留事項」（如：高管任命、預算超支、技術移轉），強制要求需雙方一致同意 (Unanimous Consent)
總經理與財務長指派 (C-Suite Appointments)：堅持由我方指派合資公司的 CEO/CTO 以掌控營運與技術，妥協由當地夥伴指派 CFO 以處理在地稅務
en: Economic vs. Voting Rights: Even if local regulations cap our equity at 49%, we must structurally engineer 'Board Majority' or 'Golden Veto' rights via the Articles of Association.
Reserved Matters: Enshrining a strict list of 15 'Reserved Matters' (e.g., C-Suite appointments, budget deviations, IP transfers) within the SHA that require Unanimous Consent.
C-Suite Appointments: Mandating our right to appoint the JV's CEO and CTO to control operations and technology, while conceding the CFO role to the local partner for domestic tax navigation.

speaker_notes.zh: 在跨國合資中，『股權』不等於『控制權』。就算當地法規規定我們只能佔 49%，我們也必須透過合約設計，把董事會的實際控制權拿在手裡。特別是『重大保留事項』，只要涉及技術移轉或高管換人，沒有我們點頭，對方絕對不能強行通過。此外，我們必須把控 CEO 和 CTO 的大位，把命脈抓在自己手上。
speaker_notes.en: In cross-border JVs, 'Equity' does not equal 'Control.' Even if local laws restrict us to a 49% stake, we will legally engineer de facto control through Board composition. Crucially, regarding 'Reserved Matters'—such as IP transfers or executive firings—the partner cannot act without our explicit veto clearance. Furthermore, we must appoint the CEO and CTO, holding the operational and technological lifelines firmly in our hands.

slide_title.zh: 智財權護城河與人才派駐 (IP Ring-fencing & HR Secondment)

zh: IP 授權而非轉讓 (License, Not Transfer)：我方投入的核心技術僅以「非專屬授權 (Non-exclusive License)」方式提供給 JV，絕不進行技術所有權的實質轉讓
衍生 IP 歸屬 (Derivative IP Ownership)：明確界定 JV 在營運期間產生的「改良技術/衍生 IP」，母公司擁有永久免費的全球使用權
關鍵人才派駐 (Talent Secondment)：由 HR 制定嚴格的「派駐協議」，確保我方派往 JV 的核心工程師，其薪酬、考績與忠誠度仍直屬母公司
en: License, Not Transfer: Our core technology is injected into the JV strictly via a 'Non-Exclusive License,' absolutely prohibiting the outright transfer of IP ownership.
Derivative IP Ownership: Contractually stipulating that any 'Derivative IP' or improvements generated by the JV grant the Parent Company a perpetual, royalty-free global license.

Talent Secondment (HR): HR will execute rigid 'Secondment Agreements,' ensuring that our core engineers deployed to the JV retain their compensation, performance metrics, and ultimate allegiance strictly to our Parent Company.

speaker_notes.zh: 很多企業做 JV，最後技術被對方整碗端走，培養出一個未來的競爭對手。法務部已經踩死紅線：我們的核心技術只『授權』，不『賣斷』。而且 JV 改良的任何技術，母公司都能免費拿回來用。同時，HR 團隊會確保我們派過去的『遠征軍』，他們的心跟薪水都還是掛在母公司，防止他們被合資夥伴策反。
speaker_notes.en: Many JVs end in catastrophe when the local partner misappropriates the tech, creating a future competitor. Legal has drawn a hard red line: we 'License' our core IP; we do not 'Transfer' it. Any tech improvements the JV develops automatically grant us a royalty-free license. Concurrently, HR ensures our 'expeditionary force' of seconded engineers remains financially and operationally tethered to the Parent Company, immunizing them against local poaching.

slide_title.zh: 僵局處理與高階調解機制 (Deadlock Resolution & Mediation)

zh: 僵局定義 (Defining Deadlock)：當合資雙方在連續兩次董事會中，針對「重大保留事項」無法達成共識，即正式觸發僵局處理機制
強制冷靜與調解 (Cooling-off & Mediation)：在啟動破局條款前，強制進入 30 天冷靜期，並引入具備國際認證資格之「第三方商業調解員 (Mediator)」進行居中斡旋
CEO 終極談判 (CEO Escalation)：若調解無效，爭議將強制升級 (Escalate) 至雙方母公司 CEO 進行最後的閉門談判，窮盡一切挽救心血的可能
en: Defining Deadlock: Formally triggering the deadlock mechanism if the JV Board fails to reach consensus on a 'Reserved Matter' across two consecutive board meetings.
Cooling-off & Mediation: Before triggering dissolution, enforcing a mandatory 30-day cooling-off period, deploying globally certified 'Third-Party Commercial Mediators' to facilitate resolution.
CEO Escalation: If mediation fails, the dispute is forcefully escalated to the Parent Company CEOs for a final closed-door summit, exhausting all avenues to salvage the venture.

speaker_notes.zh: 既然是兩家公司共治，『吵架』是遲早的事。我們最怕的是一吵架公司就停擺。因此，我們在合約裡寫入了完美的『僵局處理機制』。在雙方決定撕破臉之前，必須強制進入冷靜期，並聘請專業的商業調解員介入。如果還是談不攏，最後才會升級到雙方 CEO 出面。這套機制能最大程度地把情緒剝離，用理性的商業利益來解決衝突。
speaker_notes.en: In a co-governed entity, 'friction' is a mathematical certainty. Our greatest fear is operational paralysis during a dispute. Therefore, we have embedded a flawless 'Deadlock Resolution Mechanism.' Before either side can hit the nuclear button, we mandate a cooling-off period facilitated by Professional Commercial Mediators. If that fails, it escalates to a CEO-to-CEO summit. This structure strips away emotion, forcing resolution purely on rational commercial interests.

slide_title.zh: 退場機制：婚前協議與俄羅斯輪盤 (Exit Strategy & The Pre-Nup)
slide_title.en: Exit Strategy: The Pre-Nup & Russian Roulette

zh: 看跌與看漲選擇權 (Put/Call Options)：綁定特定的 KPI 或時間點（如合資第五年），賦予我方按約定估值買下對方股權 (Call)，或強制對方買回我方股權 (Put) 的權利
俄羅斯輪盤條款 (Russian Roulette)：若僵局徹底無解，任一方可向對方提出收購報價；對方必須選擇『接受報價賣出』，或『以同等價格反向買下出價方』，確保最終和平分手
決策訴求 (Call to Action)：懇請董事會核准本次 JV 談判之戰略底線 (Term Sheet)，並授權法務長簽署具備上述退出防禦機制的最終合約
en: Put/Call Options: Pegging options to specific KPIs or timelines (e.g., Year 5), granting us the right to buy out the partner (Call) or force them to buy our stake (Put) at a pre-agreed valuation formula.

Russian Roulette Clause: In an unsolvable deadlock, Party A offers to buy Party B's stake at Price X. Party B must either accept the cash and exit, or buy Party A's stake at that exact Price X—guaranteeing a clean divorce.
Call to Action: Requesting Board approval for the JV Term Sheet bottom-lines, and empowering the General Counsel to execute the definitive SHA containing these ironclad exit defenses.

speaker_notes.zh: 最完美的合資合約，就是一開始就把『離婚條款』寫清楚。我們設立了 Put/Call 選擇權，如果 JV 做得好，我們有權力把它全部買下來；如果做得爛，我們可以逼對方吞下去。萬一遇到死結，我們還有『俄羅斯輪盤』條款，誰出價，對方就有權反買，這保證了價格的絕對公平，也能確保合資企業最終能和平拆夥。懇請董事會授權，讓我們帶著這套護城河上談判桌。
speaker_notes.en: The perfect JV contract is essentially an airtight 'Pre-Nuptial Agreement.' We have embedded Put/Call options: if the JV thrives, we have the right to buy them out; if it tanks, we can force them to buy us out. In a terminal deadlock, we deploy the 'Russian Roulette' clause, forcing a mathematically fair buyout and a clean divorce. I request the Board's authorization to take this heavily armored Term Sheet to the negotiation table.

prompt_template.zh: 請以繁體中文製作一份大師級的『跨國合資企業 (JV) 與戰略聯盟』簡報。受眾為董事會、CEO 或潛在合資夥伴。內容必須展現結合商業戰略、法理防禦與高階調解 (Mediation) 的頂尖視野：1. 運用 SCQA 點出進軍海外/新領域的壁壘，及 JV 失敗率極高的現實，2. 探討如何透過『重大保留事項』在持股劣勢下確保營運控制權，3. 說明 IP 的『授權不轉讓』原則與 HR 對關鍵派駐人才的忠誠度控管，4. 強烈聚焦於『僵局處理 (Deadlock)』，並帶入第三方商業調解與 CEO 升級談判的實務機制，5. 結尾給出完美的『退場機制 (Exit Strategy)』，包含 Put/Call Options 與俄羅斯輪盤條款。每張 Slide 不超過 3 個重點，語氣需極具商業侵略性、合約嚴謹度與運籌帷幄的談判底氣。
prompt_template.en: Please create a master-class 'Cross-Border Joint Venture (JV) & Strategic Alliance' presentation in English. Audience: Board of Directors, CEO, or Potential Partners. Demonstrate the elite capability of bridging commercial strategy, legal defense, and advanced Mediation: 1. Use SCQA to frame market entry barriers and the statistically high failure rate of JVs. 2. Detail how to engineer operational control via 'Reserved Matters' even with minority equity. 3. Architect IP ring-fencing ('License, not Transfer') and strict HR protocols for seconded talent. 4. Focus intensely on 'Deadlock Resolution,' introducing mandatory Commercial Mediation and CEO escalation pathways. 5. Conclude with a bulletproof 'Exit Strategy' (Pre-Nup), utilizing Put/Call Options and the 'Russian Roulette' clause. Max 3 bullet points per slide. The tone must project commercial aggression, rigorous contractual supremacy, and supreme negotiation mastery.
